{{Quote|Have you even heard of rooze, Admiral Screed?"<br />"Yes. A strain of germ warfare used during the Mavvan Conflict. It destroyed as many Imperials as it did rebels. We'd never used it again.|[[Bisad Koong]] and [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]]|<ref name="The Frozen Citadel" />}}
The '''Mavvan Conflict''' was a series of skirmishes<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" /> fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and rebels<ref name="The Frozen Citadel" /> between the [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="Chronology note" /> During the conflict, the Empire unleashed a [[Bioweapon/Legends|biological agent]], the [[Rooze Disease|rooze germ]], which [[Death/Legends|killed]] just as many Imperials as it did rebels. Because of this the Empire used Rooze never again.
Immune to the disease,<ref name="The Frozen Citadel" /> [[Kobok/Legends|Koboks]] who earned distinction during the Mavvan Conflict were awarded the [[Koboth Insurgent Mantle]]. The conflict lead to the creation of the [[Kobothi S-Corps]], while also defining the [[Species/Legends|species']] reputation as capable warriors<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" /> and causing the Empire to discontinue its use of the rooze virus in [[germ warfare]].<ref name="The Frozen Citadel" />

The Kobok [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Gaff]] wore an [[Koboth]] Insurgent Mantle, though it was unknown whether [[Gender/Legends|he]] actually earned it or acquired the mantle from a veteran of the Mavvan Conflict.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" /> It shared its name with the [[Mavva system/Legends|Mavva system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mavvan Conflict was first mentioned in "[[The Frozen Citadel]]," the thirteenth and final episode of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'',<ref name="The Frozen Citadel" /> which originally aired on [[November 30]], [[1985]].<ref name="The Lost Prince air date">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> While ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'' the spelled the conflict's title as "Mavvan,"<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" /> the DVD subtitles for ''[[Treasure of the Hidden Planet]]'' spelled it "Maven."<ref name="Treasure of the Hidden Planet">''[[Treasure of the Hidden Planet]]''</ref>
